title: Baby Girl in White Dress, Wooden Toy Cart - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white studio or home portrait of a sweet infant or young toddler sitting on a small rustic wooden bench or toy wheelbarrow. The baby is wearing a light-colored dress or smock, soft baby shoes with socks, and has a tiny bow or ribbon pinned in their wispy hair. Behind them is a decorative panel or chalkboard featuring an illustrated countryside scene with a barn, clouds, and flowers, capturing mid-century domestic portraiture aesthetics.
